alternative_explanations: Any gain may come from ordinary context smoothing or random partition ensembling rather than learned conditional execution.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any frozen corpus hash or byte-length mismatch.
Invalidate if an implementable candidate receives paths, roles, offsets, future bytes or another test slot's state.
Invalidate if test updates change shared slow state or tuning occurs after scoring output.
Invalidate if a mandatory PPM, CTW, LZ or dense autoregressive control is absent.

Invalidate if the three conditional-execution roles differ in expert bank, constants, initialization, data order, input representation, update rule or output rule beyond the preregistered router-learning and active-expert-count interventions.
Invalidate if the all-experts role skips an expert or if the frozen-router role changes router parameters.

confounds: One-pass competitive routing can collapse experts or couple specialization to arbitrary byte embedding coordinates.
falsification_criteria: Discard if any K/D cell misses any 0.1671047931063159 bpb margin over either source-identical ablation, misses the 0.60 query-work ratio, violates exact K independence, exceeds state, becomes nonfinite or is Pareto-dominated by a complete simpler control.

outcome_policy.negative: End this exact four-expert top-2 configuration without tuning and return sparse modular routing to dormant status.
outcome_policy.null: Only an incomplete mandatory comparison is inconclusive; do not tune router or expert constants.
outcome_policy.positive: The exact frozen conditional-execution mechanism merits unchanged multi-seed adversarial replication; no general MoE or successor claim is permitted.

predicted_outcome: In every K/D cell main improves mean, cold and worst-file bpb over both source-identical ablations by at least 0.1671047931063159, uses under 0.60 of all-experts query operations, remains K-independent at fixed D and is implementably Pareto-nondominated.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote; a positive one-seed scout only authorizes unchanged three-seed adversarial replication after prior-art review.
research_question: Can a router learned only from anonymous byte contexts make top-2 expert execution more accurate and cheaper than source-identical all-experts and frozen-router systems at full cost?
title: Anonymous learned conditional execution quick
